title: The Truth of the Twin Souls
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to touch that spot of light, a familiar low murmur echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record—it was Chen Nian's voice: 'Brother, don't...'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in his mind like thunder piercing through his ears. Chen Ji's heart seized, his fingers unconsciously gripping the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment tighter. That voice carried an unprecedented urgency, even mixed with a fear he had never heard from Mo Xiansheng before. 'Don't agree to him! He's deceiving you!' The runes on the fragment agitated intensely, as if trying to break free from the paper's restraint. The Demonic Path Commander stopped ten zhang away, his profound gaze piercing through the night, fixed directly on Chen Ji, yet his smile grew increasingly playful.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander let out a low chuckle that echoed through the empty valley, carrying an indefinable significance. 'Mo Xiansheng, Mo Xiansheng, a thousand years have passed, yet your vigilance remains unchanged.' 'What he says is correct,' Chen Ji replied, voice deep as his right hand subtly grasped the talisman hidden in his sleeve. 'Who are you? Why do you know Chen Tianming's name?' The Demonic Path Commander stood with hands clasped behind him, his black robe fluttering sharply in the night wind. He did not answer directly; instead, he raised his head to gaze at the crescent moon obscured by dark clouds, a trace of nostalgia flickering in his eyes. 'Do you know, long, long ago, someone stood here too, asking me the very same question.'

text.content: The wind in the valley suddenly ceased, as if heaven and earth were both holding their breath in anticipation. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly; the runes on the Tianji Record pulsed even more intensely. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again in his mind, this time carrying a hint of solemnity: 'The person he speaks of... is me. A thousand years ago, I first encountered him here. Back then, I didn't know he was a severed fragment of compassion, thinking only that he was a youth who had wandered into the forbidden grounds.' The Demonic Path Commander seemed to sense something, his lips curving into a complex arc. 'Mo Xiansheng, your memories are recovering faster than I anticipated.' 'You...' Chen Ji's heart was shaken violently, his gaze darting repeatedly between the Demonic Path Commander and the Tianji Record, an absurd thought surfacing in his mind.

dialogue.content: 'You're correct.' The Demonic Path Commander turned around, his face hidden in shadow finally completely exposed beneath the moonlight—sharp brows and star-like eyes, deep-set features, bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, yet with an added steadiness of one who has weathered countless storms. 'I am not Chen Tianming. I am the compassionate essence he severed a thousand years ago.' 'The severed... compassionate essence?' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly erupted with blinding golden light, and Mo Xiansheng's phantom emerged from within. The Soul Guardian stared at the Demonic Path Commander, his expression profoundly complicated. 'A thousand years ago, Chen Tianming foresaw his fate of being completely devoured by the Heavenly Dao. To preserve a chance of survival, he made a desperate decision—to sever his own compassionate essence, allowing it to grow independently.' 'And you are that severed existence.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. 'You were meant to be Chen Tianming's guardian. Why did you end up on this path?'

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander threw his head back in laughter, yet within that laughter lay boundless desolation. The sound echoed through the valley, startling a flock of night crows. 'Why? Mo Xiansheng, did you think I had a choice?' He spun around abruptly, his black robe sweeping up a fierce gust of wind. 'When Chen Tianming severed me, he bequeathed unto me all memories and missions concerning the Heavenly Dao. I wandered alone through the mortal realm for a century before finally comprehending what I truly am.' 'I am the essence of compassion, yet I bear the destiny of opposing the Heavenly Dao.' 'I am Chen Tianming's hope, yet I am also the first target the Heavenly Dao seeks to eliminate.' He walked step by step toward Chen Ji, each step seeming to tread upon Chen Ji's heartstrings. 'To survive, to fulfill that mission bestowed upon me by I know not whom, I had no choice but to disguise myself as one of the Demonic Path. For a millennium, I have watched the Eye of Heavenly Dao strategize, watched it crush prophecy after prophecy as mere pieces on its board.' 'And I could only stand aside and watch.'

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander halted a mere three feet before Chen Ji, his deep-set eyes fixed directly upon this youth who had inherited the Tianji Record. 'Until you appeared.' 'The final inheritor of Chen Tianming, the new master of the Tianji Record.' His voice softened unexpectedly. 'Do you know? The moment you first activated the Tianji Record, I sensed it. That was the breath of heavenly fate, the last lingering attachment of Chen Tianming in this mortal realm.' 'So you came to me,' Chen Ji said coldly, 'not for any so-called cooperation. What you truly desire is the Tianji Record.' 'No.' The Demonic Path Commander shook his head. 'What I desire is—to annihilate the Eye of Heavenly Dao.' 'Only by destroying it can I attain true freedom.' 'Only by destroying it can you break free from the destiny of being manipulated as a piece.' 'Our enemy, from the very beginning until now, has been one and the same.' Mo Xiansheng's phantom flickered, as if lost in contemplation. After a long while, his voice resonated in Chen Ji's mind: 'What he says... holds some credibility. But a thousand years is more than enough time to transform anyone, Chen Ji. You must ultimately make this choice yourself.'

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent, yet his mind raced at breakneck speed. The foresight ability of the Tianji Record activated spontaneously at this moment, and a hazy vision materialized before his eyes—the Demonic Path Commander standing amidst utter devastation, behind him countless mountains lay in ruins, and before him, an enormous eye was slowly opening, its pupil reflecting a vast network of intertwining Heavenly Dao laws. That was the true form of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the prophetic vision. 'On what grounds should I trust you?' His voice was calm, yet carried an unwavering edge. 'A thousand years ago you were severed; a thousand years later you become the Demonic Path Commander. What have you done during this interval? The Demonic Path invasions I have witnessed, the suffering of countless lives—were all of these merely part of your so-called 'disguise'?'

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander did not fly into a rage; instead, a bitter smile appeared on his face. "Good, a fine question." "The Demonic Path invasion was orchestrated by me." "The mutual destruction among the three great sects was also my handiwork." "Countless innocent lives lost—these are all facts." His composure was chillingly matter-of-fact, as if narrating something utterly unrelated to himself. "But do you know, with every scheme I meticulously crafted, I carefully selected the sacrifices? Every person who died by my hand was inevitably a target that Heaven's Eye intended to erase. I merely transferred those individuals onto my chessboard before it could act." "A roundabout way of saving lives?" Chen Ji raised an eyebrow. "At least it's better than being devoured by Heaven's Eye as spiritual fodder." The Demonic Path Commander's voice cooled. "Do you think Heaven's Eye sustains its existence how? It feeds on the Heavenly Fate of all beings. Every fallen prophet, every massive conflict—these are its feasts." "And I merely snatch a few scraps from its banquet."

text.content: The wind swept away the lingering clouds, moonlight fading gradually. Chen Ji stared into the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, attempting to find any flaw. Yet those eyes were as deep as an abyss—nothing but absolute composure, nothing else. That was the tranquility only accumulated over a millennium of沉淀. Alarms rang in Chen Ji's heart, yet he had to admit that perhaps not everything his opponent said was lies. The runes on the Tianji Record gradually quieted. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of lament this time: "Chen Ji, what he says is true. When I first encountered him a thousand years ago, he was merely a confused youth. Now... he has grown to a level even I cannot see through." "But this doesn't mean you should trust him completely." Mo Xiansheng pivoted, "A thousand years is enough time for any being to change. He may genuinely wish to oppose Heaven's Eye, but his methods, his purpose—those may not align with yours."

Chen Ji nodded slightly, having already made his calculations. He spoke slowly, his voice devoid of any emotion: "Cooperation is possible. But I have three conditions." The Demonic Path Commander's brow slightly lifted, as if he had anticipated this. "First, you must tell me everything you know—about Heaven's Eye, about Chen Tianming, about the true origin of the Tianji Record." "Agreed." "Second, our actions must be mutually known. Any scheme against Heaven's Eye must not be concealed from the other party." "Reasonable." "Third—" Chen Ji paused, his gaze sharp as a blade, "If you harbor any treacherous intent, I possess the power to condemn you to eternal damnation." As his words fell, the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with golden light. A majestic surge of power erupted from within Chen Ji's body—that was the source power of the Tianji Record, a trump card he had never revealed before outsiders. The Demonic Path Commander's pupils slightly contracted, then burst into hearty laughter. "Good! Excellent! What a Chen Ji! Truly worthy of being Chen Tianming's inheritor!" His laughter ceased, his expression becoming unprecedentedly serious, "Your three conditions, I accept. But I also have a proposal."

"What proposal?" Chen Ji maintained vigilance. The golden light of the Tianji Record still enveloped him, ready to transform into the sharpest killing technique at any moment. The Demonic Path Commander took a deep breath, uttering a word that shocked everyone present. "Twin Union." "What does that mean?" Chen Ji frowned. "What Chen Tianming sliced away back then wasn't merely the benevolent thoughts." The Demonic Path Commander's voice was low, "He also sliced away the malevolent thoughts. The malevolent thoughts transformed into the source power of the Tianji Record, sealed within this secret manual. For a thousand years, the Tianji Record sought inheritors, but in truth, it was searching for someone capable of reuniting the benevolent and malevolent aspects." "Only when good and evil unite can I truly merge with the Tianji Record and unleash the complete power to oppose Heaven's Eye." He stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "And you—you are the one chosen by the Tianji Record." "You mean to say..." Chen Ji's heart trembled violently. The Tianji Record suddenly quivered intensely. Mo Xiansheng's exclaimed in alarm within his mind: "Impossible! The price of Twin Union is too devastating! Back then, Chen Tianming chose to slice away precisely because he couldn't endure—"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's phantom flickered intensely, clearly overwhelmed by emotions. "Chen Ji, listen to me! Twin Union isn't simple fusion—that's thoroughly intertwining two people's consciousness, Heavenly Fate, even souls! Once successful, you will share everything—including memories, power, and... weaknesses!" "Chen Tianming back then precisely couldn't endure such a price, so he chose to slice away. And now, this demon wants you to repeat his mistake!" The Demonic Path Commander listened quietly without rebuttal. Only after Mo Xiansheng finished did he speak lightly: "You're right. Twin Union carries risks." "But have you told Chen Ji what the consequences of not doing this are?" His gaze fell upon the Tianji Record, "Heaven's Eye has already set its sights on him. With his current strength, he fundamentally cannot contend with Heaven's Eye. Every use of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate Value, and the day those values are exhausted—" "That will be his death." Mo Xiansheng fell silent. Chen Ji also fell silent.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's proposal struck like thunderclap, exploding in Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng's warnings still echoed in his ears, the price of the Tianji Record hung above him like a sword. Yet the threat of Heaven's Eye loomed imminent, leaving no room for retreat. How should one choose?

choices.description: Accept the Twin Union proposal and thoroughly merge with the Demonic Path Commander to jointly oppose Heaven's Eye. This means entrusting one's fate to the other party, but may also acquire unprecedented power.
choices.visible_cost: Lose independence and share everything with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete power of the Tianji Record, the capital to oppose Heaven's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng warns this method carries devastating costs and unpredictable consequences

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, there was not a trace of hesitation in his gaze. "Very well. I agree." A genuine smile bloomed on the Demonic Path Commander's face, a smile carrying a millennium of unprecedented relief. "You will not regret this." He extended his hand. A crystalline point of light emerged in his palm—that was the source of his benevolent thoughts accumulated over a thousand years.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's phantom trembled intensely but did not interfere again. He quietly gazed at the two of them, a complex light flickering in his eyes. "Since it's come to this... I, this old man, shall wager this round with you." The Tianji Record slowly opened. Golden light enveloped the figures of both men. A fusion capable of altering destiny was about to commence.

choices.description: Accept cooperation to oppose Heaven's Eye, but temporarily refrain from Twin Union. First gather more information, preserve respective independence, and make decisions when the timing matures.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to immediately obtain complete power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the ability for independent judgment, reduce risk
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity, but retain an escape route

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his extended hand stopping mid-air. "Cooperation is possible. But the Twin Union—I need time to consider." A trace of regret flickered in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, but he quickly let it go. "No matter. This decision is weighty indeed. Take your time to answer." He waved his sleeve, and a streak of light flew toward Chen Ji, transforming into an ancient Jade Slip. "This is the information about the Eye of Heavenly Dao that I've collected over a thousand years. Perhaps it will be useful to you."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his mind, carrying a hint of praise: "Cautious yet rational—this is the correct choice. The cost of the Twin Union is too great, acting rashly will only harm yourself." Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his chest, raising his head to look at the Demonic Path Commander. "I will read the information. But before that, I have another question." His gaze suddenly sharpened. "Where is Chen Nian?" The Demonic Path Commander's expression slightly froze, then quickly returned to normal. "Your sister... indeed has a connection to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. But this matter is long to tell, let's find a place and talk slowly."

choices.description: Do not blindly trust the Demonic Path Commander's words, remain on guard. Intelligence can be exchanged, but never surrender one's destiny to the other. Cooperation is only temporary; each side must retain their trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: May lose the opportunity to obtain complete power
choices.visible_reward: Always maintain the initiative, never be manipulated by anyone
choices.risk_hint: Both sides will hold something back, greatly reducing the effectiveness of cooperation

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, the golden light of the Tianji Record not only did not recede but blazed even more fiercely. "Your story is精彩. But a figure from a thousand years ago—who knows if it's true or false?" The Demonic Path Commander slightly raised his brow, as if expecting this reaction. "You don't believe me." "Whether I believe or not doesn't matter." Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back. "What matters is that both you and I want to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Under this premise, we can cooperate." "But—" his voice suddenly turned cold, "if you make any suspicious moves, I'll let you know that the Tianji Record's trump cards are far more than what you've seen."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander did not become angry but laughed instead, and in that laughter was even a hint of appreciation. "Good! Good indeed, Chen Ji! Truly a spitting image of Chen Tianming back then!" He clapped his hands. "Since that's the case, our cooperation will be based on both sides retaining their trump cards. You don't trust me—I won't force you. But there's one thing I can guarantee—in dealing with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, I will never lie to you." "Because that is my only way out." The night wind blew past, carrying a falling leaf. Chen Ji gazed at this man with a face similar to his own, his heart screaming warnings. This person... is too candid. Behind such candor, what could be hidden?

text.content: At this moment, the runes of the Tianji Record suddenly violently jumped, and a blurry image emerged before Chen Ji's eyes—it was a Forbidden Grounds shrouded in blood light, a massive formation slowly operating. And at the formation's center, a slender figure was bound by countless chains, and that figure's face... was Chen Nian! Chen Ji's heart violently contracted, his hands unconsciously clenching into fists. "Chen Nian..." His voice was hoarse, almost挤出 from between his teeth. The Demonic Path Commander sensed his unusual state, his gaze falling on the Tianji Record, deep in thought. "You saw it? That is... the sealing place of the Eye of Heavenly Dao." He paused. "Your sister being taken was no accident. The Eye of Heavenly Dao needs her power to complete some crucial arrangement." "What arrangement?" Chen Ji猛地 raised his head, his eyes already icy cold.

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate Lock and Key." The Demonic Path Commander uttered four words, each as heavy as a thousand pounds. "Your sister carries a special Heavenly Fate power sealed within her—this power can open the door to the source of Heavenly Dao." "The Eye of Heavenly Dao has been searching for this key. And you—" he gave Chen Ji a meaningful glance, "the inheritor of the Tianji Record, are precisely the catalyst to unlock this key." "You two, from the very beginning, have been chess pieces chosen by the Eye of Heavenly Dao." "It intentionally separated you, intentionally let Chen Nian fall into the Holy Sect's hands—all for the day when it would sacrifice you both together to open that door." Chen Ji's blood seemed to freeze, an unprecedented chill climbing from his feet to the crown of his head. His disposition of holding grudges but not being reckless forced him to suppress the impulse of rage, but his mind raced—was all this true?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice适时响起: "What he said is true. Before Chen Tianming fell a thousand years ago, he left a prophecy about the Heavenly Fate Lock and Key. I always thought it was merely legend, never expected..." He didn't finish, but the meaning was clear. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. The Tianji Record's Foresight Ability activated again, and a new image appeared—the great pupil of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, coldly gazing upon all living beings, and under its gaze, countless threads of fate intertwined into a vast net, his and Chen Nian's threads of fate prominently among them, being gradually devoured by that net. "So," Chen Ji's voice was low, "we are all chess pieces." "All of us." The Demonic Path Commander nodded. "But chess pieces also have their uses. As long as we find the method to break the局, chess pieces can also overturn the entire game."

The night wind suddenly rose, stirring Chen Ji's robes. He gazed at the Demonic Path Commander, his目光如刀: "Since you know all this, why not say it sooner? Why wait until now?" The Demonic Path Commander沉默片刻, sighed. "Because I wasn't sure if you were worthy of trust." "The inheritor of Chen Tianming... there have been more than one in history. But every one of them, after learning the truth, met the same fate—devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Dao." "I didn't want to repeat the same mistakes." "So I've been observing you. From your restraint at Tianqing Sect, to your maneuvering between the three major sects, to your willingness to消耗Heavenly Fate Value to save those unrelated people..." "Your resolve is far stronger than I anticipated." A complex emotion flashed in his gaze. "Perhaps... this time, breaking the局 holds promise."

Chen Ji did not speak, merely gazing quietly at the other party. After a long while, he spoke: "Can you confirm Chen Nian's location?" The Demonic Path Commander nodded, waving his sleeve, and a three-dimensional light-shadow map unfurled in the air. It was the terrain of the entire Xuanyuan Continent, and in the map's northwestern corner, a region shrouded in black mist was particularly conspicuous. "The Ancient Forbidden Land—the Heavenly Dao Relic. The resting place of the Heavenly Dao Eye's本体, and where Chen Nian is imprisoned." He pointed to that black mist. "With your current strength, you根本无法闯入." "So you need me." Chen Ji stared directly into his eyes. "So I need you." The Demonic Path Commander admitted frankly, "But more importantly—you also need me. Without my guidance, you won't even find the entrance to the Forbidden Grounds."

The light-shadow map slowly dissolved, and the valley fell into darkness once more. Chen Ji turned his back, gazing toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect. The night wind brushed across his face, carrying a chill. The Tianji Record fragment in his palm grew faintly warm, and Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more: "Chen Ji, no matter what decision you make, remember one thing—Chen Nian is your weakness, but she may also become a weapon the Heavenly Dao Eye uses against you." "Before saving her, make yourself stronger first." "She's waited all these years; a little while longer won't matter." Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the scene of young Chen Nian being taken away resurfaced in his mind. That day, he had sworn to find his sister. Now, the truth was right before him—how could he possibly retreat? "I understand." He opened his eyes, turning to face the Demonic Path Commander. "Let's go. Take me to see Chen Nian."

"Now?" The Demonic Path Commander was slightly stunned, seemingly unprepared for his decisive tone. "Are you sure? The danger level of the Forbidden Grounds far exceeds your imagination, and—" Before he could finish, the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with a blinding radiance. That light pierced through the night sky, forming a massive image above the valley—the entrance to the Heavenly Dao Relic, with countless black shadows stirring restlessly. And among those shadows'簇拥, a gigantic eye was slowly opening, its pupil reflecting the figures of Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander. Their eyes met, and a chill crawled up their spines. "It has discovered us." The Demonic Path Commander's voice abruptly cooled. "It seems the plan must be moved up."
